config.approval_note: Always autoPublish=true. autoPublish=false in Metricool does NOT mean 'tap to approve': it emails Jordan the files to post by hand. Jordan reviews via the summary each run sends and can edit or delete in the Metricool planner before post time.

linkedin.rule: Every calendar post goes to the Socius LinkedIn company page first, then Instagram (+Facebook) as a separate Metricool post. LinkedIn has budget priority.
linkedin.times: LinkedIn: weekdays only, 08:45 or 12:15 Europe/London, on the Instagram date or the next weekday.
linkedin.format: Same images. Carousels: linkedinData.publishImagesAsPDF=true with a documentTitle (swipeable document). Single image: normal image post.
linkedin.caption: Rewrite for LinkedIn in the company voice ('we'), a little longer and more considered, full https:// links (clickable), max 3 hashtags, never 'link in bio'.

monthly_post_budget.note: Metricool free plan: about 20 scheduled posts per calendar month, each network counts as one post. So ~10 calendar posts a month (one every ~3 days), each on IG + LinkedIn. Before scheduling, count posts already scheduled/published in Metricool for that month; if the budget would be exceeded, move the post to next month and tell Jordan. Jordan is happy to upgrade (Starter) if this proves limiting.

x.budget: Typefully free plan: 10 published posts per calendar month. Use all 10 every month (see channel_strategy.x_credits). Check get_social_set_details publishing_quota before scheduling.
x.format: Adapt, don't copy. Carousels become a 3-6 post thread (hook first, one idea per post, CTA + https link last). Static posts become a single punchy post. Max ~260 chars per post. 0-2 hashtags. Crypto moments and conferences are X's strongest content.
x.media: Attach the cover slide to the first post of each thread (up to 4 images per post; for statics attach the image). Upload: create_media_upload, then `curl -T <file> '<upload_url>'` (no extra headers), then poll get_media_status until ready. Set alt_text. If upload fails, post text-only and say so.
x.times: Same day as Instagram, 16:30 or 17:30 Europe/London (EU evening + US East morning). Use publish_at with an explicit datetime.

facebook.rule: Add facebook as a second provider on the SAME Metricool post as Instagram (providers [instagram, facebook], facebookData {type: POST}). Same caption and images. Meta does not auto-share API posts from Instagram to Facebook.
facebook.budget_note: Unclear whether Metricool counts a two-network post as 1 or 2 against the free 20/month. If a quota error appears, drop Facebook first (keep Instagram), and tell Jordan.

photo_library.note: Only use photos from posts/photos/. Raw slide type for people photos so text never covers faces.

channel_strategy.accounts: Business accounts ONLY: Socius LinkedIn company page, @sociustalent Instagram, Socius Facebook page, @socius_talent on X. Never post to or write as Jordan's personal profiles. Jordan's personal LinkedIn already posts a Friday weekly round-up with live roles from a separate project; personal set-up may be added later.
channel_strategy.voice: Company voice everywhere: 'we' / 'us' / 'the Socius team'. Never 'I' or 'me'. Refer to Jordan in the third person ('our founder Jordan') when needed.
channel_strategy.priority: 1) LinkedIn company page (business leads), 2) X (Web3 community, use every Typefully credit), 3) Instagram, 4) Facebook (follows Instagram). Instagram/Facebook are for presence and trust, not leads.
channel_strategy.metricool_budget_order: Schedule LinkedIn first. If the monthly Metricool budget is tight, drop Facebook first, then Instagram. Never drop LinkedIn for Instagram/Facebook.
channel_strategy.x_credits: Use all 10 Typefully posts each calendar month (we need a full month of data). Calendar posts get an X version first; any spare credits go to X-only posts (entries with channels ['x']). On the last run of each month, if credits remain, schedule X-only posts to use them.
channel_strategy.linkedin_live_roles: Avoid putting company-page live-roles posts on Fridays, so they don't clash with Jordan's personal Friday round-up.
